name: Manastorm Stratholme: a solo wipe at Magistrate Barthilas ejects the player to the faction hub on release (#8179)
contract: #8179: releasing spirit after wiping in a Manastorm Stratholme run never reached ManastormMgr::HandleReleaseAfterWipe
because ascension_dungeon_release_player (src/server/coa/AscensionDungeonRelease.cpp) registers before module scripts
and handled every dungeon map without excluding scripted private instances. Its OnPlayerCanRepopAtGraveyard matched
Stratholme's public areatrigger_teleport entrance, resurrected the player at 50% health inside the private Manastorm
instance, and returned false, short-circuiting PLAYERHOOK_CAN_REPOP_AT_GRAVEYARD before manastorm_playerscript ran.
The fix excludes Map::IsScriptedPrivateInstance() in AscensionDungeonRelease so Manastorm's own release handler
runs FailRun and returns the player alive to their faction Manastorm hub pad (Orgrimmar guid 6901539, map 1).
Discriminating assertions: after release_spirit, private_instance drops to 0, alive is 1, map_id is 1, and
point_distance_2d to (1648.1, -4431.11) is within 5 yd; without the fix, private_instance stays 1 on map 329.

steps.label: SETUP: the player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the instance is visible to this lane
SETUP: leaving the preparation bubble at Magistrate Barthilas clears its safety aura and activates the stage
SETUP: the lone member is dead and the run wiped to AwaitingExit
DISCRIMINATING: releasing spirit ejected the player out of the private Manastorm instance
DISCRIMINATING: the player is alive after Manastorm wipe ejection
DISCRIMINATING: the player landed on Kalimdor (map 1), not Stratholme (map 329)
DISCRIMINATING: the player landed at the Horde Manastorm hub pad in Orgrimmar
